NIST certificate data attribution and modification notice

Source: National Institute of Standards and Technology (2025), Standard Reference
Material 1643f, Trace Elements in Water, Certificate of Analysis, issued
28 April 2025. https://tsapps.nist.gov/srmext/certificates/1643f.pdf
Accessed 17 November 2026.

The CSV transcribes four rows (Ca, Mg, Sr, Zn) from the mass-concentration column
of Table 1, preserving the certified values, expanded uncertainties and individual
coverage factors. It is not a spectrum or a set of measurements acquired for this
course. Modification by Yunhao Yang, 17 November 2026: selection of four rows,
machine-readable CSV transcription, original visual presentation and conversion
of micrograms per litre to milligrams per litre in the generated output. No
certified numerical value is otherwise changed. The certificate's mass-fraction
column is a distinct quantity and is not used. No NIST logo is reproduced.
